channel.title: Qofeno — editorial discoveries
channel.description: Interesting independent websites selected for Qofeno’s editorial collection. These are not paid placements and do not affect sponsored rankings.

item.title: The Public Domain Review
item.description: Essays and unusual finds from the history of art, books and ideas. Start with the collections: old maps, curious photographs and forgotten stories. Editorial selection, not a paid placement.

item.title: Standard Ebooks
item.description: Classic books carefully proofread and typeset for a better reading experience. Volunteer-produced editions drawn from texts in the US public domain. Editorial selection, not a paid placement.

item.title: Radio Garden
item.description: Turn a globe and listen to live radio stations from different places. Choose a place you have never visited and see what is playing. Editorial selection, not a paid placement.

item.title: WindowSwap
item.description: Look through windows shared by people around the world. A change of scenery, from somebody else’s everyday view. Editorial selection, not a paid placement.

item.title: Fonts In Use
item.description: See how typefaces work in real books, posters, packaging and websites. Browse by typeface, format or subject to find the detail you came for. Editorial selection, not a paid placement.

item.title: Neal.fun
item.description: Small interactive experiments, visualizations and games by Neal. An invitation to click around and find something unexpected. Editorial selection, not a paid placement.
